title: Hypothesis: The Universe as an Energy-Driven System – Integrating Time, Space, Consciousness, and Thermodynamics
abstract: Proposes Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC), a framework in which energy flow and the second law of thermodynamics govern the emergence and collapse of time, space, and consciousness. Introduces an entropy-scaled state variable S with boundaries at S=0 (singularity) and S=1 ("altular" maximum entropy), and outlines qualitative predictions for redshift behavior, time dilation, and consciousness thresholds.
